items.title: 〈美股盤後〉AI強勢回血！標普創2025年4月來最佳單周 Sandisk飆16% Anthropic重返IPO價
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: AI Leads Strong Recovery, S&P Posts Best Weekly Gain Since April 2025, Sandisk Jumps 16%, Anthropic Returns to IPO Price
paras: 人工智慧(AI)股吹起反彈號角，幫助美股主要指數周五(27日)全面收高，結束這個劇烈波動且因假期縮短的一周。道瓊一周來上漲近600點，創2022年來最大單周漲點，標普500指數也締造2025年4月以來最佳單周表現。
美股周四因感恩節休市一天，周五雖然恢復交易，但提早收盤。
本月遭投資人重挫的晶片股收復近期部分失土，美光(MU-US)與邁威爾)(Marvell)(MRVL-US)周五分別上漲7.6%及7.3%。 AI受惠股也大幅走高，資料儲存業者Sandisk(SNDK-US)股價飆漲近16%，光學產品製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)及伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)分別勁揚8%和6.7%。
營運大型資料中心的大型AI雲端業者(Hyperscalers)，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta Platforms(META-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)，股價全面上漲。
川普周四坦承，近期市場動盪一度讓他感到擔憂。這波震盪格外劇烈，是數月來籠罩華爾街的市場波動進一步升高的表現，反映AI熱潮背後的金融與經濟利害關係日益重大。
本周稍早公布的數據顯示，美國經濟第3季成長速度遠高於初估，10月通膨也進一步加速。交易員幾乎完全押注聯準會(Fed)將在12月升息。
本周道瓊工業指數上漲5.46%，標普500指數上漲5.6%，那斯達克指數上漲6.68%，使三大指數創下2008年以來最佳感恩節周的表現。當時正逢金融危機期間，三大指數當年周漲幅各為9.7%、12%、10.9%。
不過本周的反彈仍不足以收復11月以來的跌幅，標普500指數與那斯達克指數恐交出2008年以來最差11月表現。市場擔憂民主黨贏得美國期中選舉後，AI監管可能趨嚴，加上貨幣政策預料將持續緊縮，都對股市構成壓力。
美股周五(27日)主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲591.99點，或1.18%，收50,774.94點。
那斯達克綜合指數上漲543.70點，或2.31%，收24,129.50點。
標普500指數上漲114.71點，或1.60%，收7,297.49點。
費城半導體指數上漲411.84點，或4.69%，收9,186.71點。
NYSE FANG+ 指數上漲452.98點，或2.82%，收16,510.93點。


標普11大類股中全數上漲，基本金屬、科技類股漲最多。

焦點個股

NYSE FANG + 指數中的科技五大巨頭多上揚。Meta(META-US)上漲3.13%；蘋果(AAPL-US)上漲0.83%；Alphabet(GOOGL-US)下跌0.68%；微軟(MSFT-US)上漲0.60%；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)上漲3.96%。
費半成分股幾乎全面上漲。Coherent(COHR-US)飆逾14%，美光(MU-US)大漲7.6%，邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)漲7.3%，英特爾(INTC-US)漲4.75%，超微(AMD-US)漲3.87%。
台股ADR跌漲互見。台積電ADR(TSM-US)上漲3.21%；日月光 ADR(ASX-US)上漲6.27%；聯電ADR(UMC-US)上漲1.90%；中華電信ADR(CHT-US)上漲0.54%。

企業新聞

Anthropic(ANT-US)周五大漲10.98%，收在每股91.88美元，重新站上每股83美元的首次公開發行(IPO)價，反映AI交易全面回溫，吸引從假期重返市場的投資人，分析師的正面評等也為股價提供支撐。
由阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)領導的Anthropic目前市值約1.7兆美元，仍低於11月19日掛牌首日股價觸及115.10美元時、市值一度超過2兆美元的高點。 投資人接下來將觀察，Anthropic能否在12月15日閉鎖期屆滿前，持續守住IPO發行價
SpaceX(SPCX-US)勁揚4.83%，報每股133.59美元。全球首富馬斯克在感恩節當天於社群平台X發文表示，除了贈送美國每個兒童2股SpaceX股票之外，每年還會加碼贈送1股，以目前股價計算，每年額外贈股的總價值將近90億美元。
輝達周五盤中走勢震盪，終場勉力上漲0.8%，報每股150.49美元。黃仁勳戲劇性回鍋擔任執行長之後，預定下周四赴美國參議院銀行委員會作證，將成為市場焦點。標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)周三則將輝達信用評等列入「負向觀察」名單，代表評等遭調降的可能性很高。
行動通訊巨頭威瑞森(Verizon Communications)(VZ-US)上漲0.55%，報每股47.54美元。《金融時報》(FT)報導，該公司正洽談以60億美元收購寬頻業者Fidium，藉此擴大網路版圖，在全美吸引更多網路服務用戶。
Vertex Pharmaceuticals(VRTZ-US)重挫5.2%，報每股534.57美元。美國監管機關宣布，該公司治療慢性腎臟疾病藥物的核准決定將延後最多三個月，為此藥上市之路新增障礙。

華爾街分析

經過數周市場不安，投資人持續質疑AI支出能否帶來相應回報，企業借貸成本上升、監管趨嚴，以及這項技術帶來的風險等問題，仍未獲得解答。市場接下來將密切觀察，AI股這波賣壓是否已經告一段落。
摩根士丹利投資管理公司資深投資組合經理Andrew Slimmon說：「科技股反彈從周一開始，周三盤中反轉後延續，今天又持續走高。大量短線資金已經解除科技股部位，這波反彈下周可能持續，因為這些資金被迫回頭追買。」
Annex財富管理公司分析師Brian Jacobsen表示，當市場發現原先擔憂的風險並未實現，先前的避險賣壓最終就會逆轉。他並指出，長期投資人會把市場修正視為重新檢視持股的時機，而不是退出市場的理由。
Jacobsen表示：「購物者在這個假期購物季會尋找便宜貨，沒有理由認為投資人不能做同樣的事。」
目前由於風險偏好回升，投資人減少對美國公債等避險資產的需求。
The Sevens Report的Tom Essaye指出，本周市場表現最重要的訊息是，AI投資題材仍有許多問題亟待解決。他表示：「在市場能夠清楚掌握接下來的發展之前，我們應該預期波動將持續。」
下周市場焦點將轉向美國11月非農就業報告，這是Fed 12月8日至9日政策會議前最受矚目的經濟數據，若數據顯示美國經濟愈來愈熱絡，可能促使央行採取更強硬的立場，對已經遭受重創的股票構成壓力。
根據LSEG調查的經濟學家預估，美國11月非農就業人口將增加9萬人，失業率為4.1%。10月非農就業人口則大增16.5萬人，遠高於經濟學家的預期。
Wealth Enhancement資深投資策略師Ayako Yoshioka說：「強勁的經濟成長背景，只會給Fed另一個更有信心升息的理由。因此，這是一把雙面刃。」
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: AI stocks sounded the rebound bugle, helping all major U.S. indices close higher on Friday (the 27th) and ending a volatile week that was shortened by the holiday. The Dow rose nearly 600 points, its biggest weekly gain since 2022, while the S&P 500 posted its best weekly performance since April 2025.
U.S. markets were closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving, and although trading resumed on Friday, the session ended early.

Chip stocks that had been hammered this month reclaimed some of their recent losses, with Micron (MU‑US) and Marvell (MRVL‑US) up 7.6% and 7.3% respectively on Friday. AI‑benefiting names also surged: data‑storage firm Sandisk (SNDK‑US) jumped almost 16%, while optical‑product maker Lumentum (LITE‑US) and server maker Dell (DELL‑US) rose 8% and 6.7% respectively.
Large‑scale AI cloud providers (hyperscalers) – Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) – all saw their shares rise.

Trump admitted on Thursday that recent market turbulence had worried him. The swing was especially sharp, reflecting a further escalation of the volatility that has loomed over Wall Street for months and underscoring the growing financial and economic stakes behind the AI boom.
Data released earlier this week showed U.S. Q3 growth far outpacing estimates and October inflation accelerating. Traders are almost unanimously betting that the Fed will raise rates in December.

The Dow Industrial Average climbed 5.46%, the S&P 500 rose 5.6%, and the Nasdaq gained 6.68%, giving the three major indices their best Thanksgiving‑week performance since 2008. Back then, during the financial crisis, the weekly gains were 9.7%, 12% and 10.9% respectively.

However, the rebound this week was still insufficient to erase the declines since November, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq could end up delivering their worst November performance since 2008. Markets worry that a Democratic win in the U.S. midterms could tighten AI regulation, and that monetary policy is likely to stay restrictive, both weighing on equities.
U.S. market performance on Friday (the 27th):

The Dow Industrial Average rose 591.99 points, or 1.18%, to close at 50,774.94.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 543.70 points, or 2.31%, to finish at 24,129.50.
The S&P 500 added 114.71 points, or 1.60%, to end at 7,297.49.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 411.84 points, or 4.69%, to settle at 9,186.71.
The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 452.98 points, or 2.82%, to close at 16,510.93.

All 11 S&P sector groups were up, with basic materials and technology leading the gains.

Key stocks

Most of the five big‑cap tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index were higher. Meta (META‑US) rose 3.13%; Apple (AAPL‑US) up 0.83%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) slipped 0.68%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) gained 0.60%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) climbed 3.96%.

Almost all components of the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index were higher. Coherent (COHR‑US) surged more than 14%; Micron (MU‑US) jumped 7.6%; Marvell (MRVL‑US) rose 7.3%; Intel (INTC‑US) up 4.75%; AMD (AMD‑US) up 3.87%.
Taiwan ADRs showed mixed moves. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose 3.21%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 6.27%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 1.90%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 0.54%.

Company news

Anthropic (ANT‑US) surged 10.98% on Friday to close at $91.88, retaking its IPO price of $83 and reflecting a broad AI‑trade rebound that attracted investors returning from the holiday. Positive analyst ratings also supported the price.

Led by Dario Amodei, Anthropic now has a market value of about $1.7 trillion, still below the peak of over $2 trillion it briefly hit when the stock first traded on November 19 at $115.10. Investors will watch whether Anthropic can hold its IPO price through the December 15 lock‑up expiration.

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) jumped 4.83% to $133.59 per share. Billionaire Elon Musk posted on X on Thanksgiving that, in addition to giving every U.S. child two shares of SpaceX stock, he will add one more share each year. At current prices, the annual extra‑share giveaway is worth nearly $9 billion.

NVIDIA was volatile during the session on Friday but managed a modest 0.8% gain to close at $150.49. After Jensen Huang dramatically returned as CEO, he is slated to testify before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee next Thursday, making him a market focal point. S&P Global Ratings placed NVIDIA on a “negative watch” list on Wednesday, indicating a high likelihood of a rating downgrade.

Verizon Communications (VZ‑US) rose 0.55% to $47.54. The Financial Times reported the company is negotiating a $6 billion acquisition of broadband provider Fidium to expand its network footprint and attract more U.S. broadband customers.

Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTZ‑US) fell 5.2% to $534.57. U.S. regulators announced that approval of the company’s chronic kidney disease drug will be delayed by up to three months, adding another hurdle to the product’s launch.

Wall Street analysis

After weeks of market unease, investors continue to question whether AI spending will generate commensurate returns. Rising corporate borrowing costs, tighter regulation, and the inherent risks of the technology remain unresolved. The market will watch closely to see if the selling pressure on AI stocks has finally abated.

Andrew Slimmon, a senior portfolio manager at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, said: “The tech rebound started on Monday, continued after a mid‑week reversal, and kept climbing today. A lot of short‑term capital has already exited tech positions, so this bounce could persist into next week as that capital is forced to chase stocks back.”

Brian Jacobsen, an analyst at Annex Wealth Management, said that when the market sees the feared risks not materializing, the earlier hedging sell‑off will reverse. He added that long‑term investors tend to view corrections as an opportunity to reassess holdings rather than a reason to exit.
Jacobsen noted: “Shoppers look for bargains during the holiday season, and there’s no reason investors can’t do the same.”
Currently, with risk appetite returning, investors are reducing demand for safe‑haven assets such as U.S. Treasuries.

Tom Essaye of The Sevens Report said the most important takeaway from this week’s market action is that many questions surrounding AI investment remain unresolved. He warned: “Until the market can clearly see what comes next, we should expect volatility to continue.”

Next week’s focus will shift to the U.S. November non‑farm payroll report, the most closely watched data point ahead of the Fed’s Dec 8‑9 policy meeting. A stronger‑than‑expected reading could push the central bank toward a more hawkish stance, adding pressure to stocks that have already taken a hit.
Economists surveyed by LSEG expect November non‑farm payrolls to increase by 90,000 jobs, with the unemployment rate at 4.1%. October’s payrolls rose by 165,000, well above expectations.

Ayako Yoshioka, senior investment strategist at Wealth Enhancement, said: “Robust economic‑growth fundamentals only give the Fed another reason to feel confident about raising rates. So it’s a double‑edged sword.”

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI買盤回流主要指數走揚 標普500拚4月以來最佳單周表現
items.title_en: US Stocks Early Session: AI Buying Returns, Major Indices Rise, S&P 500 Targets Best Weekly Gain Since April
paras: 美股周五(27日)在感恩節假期後恢復交易，三大指數同步開高，先前遭重挫的人工智慧(AI)相關股票吸引買盤回流，道瓊工業指數上漲約300點。隨著市場風險偏好回升，美債避險需求降溫，華爾街可望以漲勢為動盪的一周收尾。
道瓊指數朝2025年4月以來最佳單周表現邁進，標普500指數也可望創下4月以來最大單周漲幅。不過，AI投資能否帶來足夠回報、借貸成本上升與監管風險等疑慮仍未消退，反彈能否延續仍是市場焦點。

AI股買盤回籠 輝達續吐近期漲幅

AI交易回溫，帶動先前一度逼近熊市的那斯達克100指數走揚，半導體類股指標也同步上漲。不過，輝達(NVDA-US)持續回吐近期大漲後的部分漲幅，走勢與整體晶片股不同調。
過去數周，投資人持續質疑科技業龐大的AI支出能否轉化為實際收益，相關股票因此承受賣壓。如今買盤重新進場，交易員正觀察這波拋售最劇烈的階段是否已經過去。
然而，股價反彈尚未替AI交易的核心問題提供答案。除了投資報酬，市場仍須面對借貸成本上升、監管措施，以及AI技術本身可能帶來的風險。
The Sevens Report的Tom Essaye表示，本周市場表現最大的啟示，是AI交易仍有許多問題有待解決。在市場對後續發展形成更清楚的判斷之前，投資人應預期波動將持續。

分析師看待回檔機會 美債避險需求降溫

Annex Wealth Management的Brian Jacobsen指出，當市場擔憂的情境沒有成真，先前因恐懼而進行的交易就會逐步回轉，賣壓最終也會逆轉。因此，長期投資人通常把回檔視為重新檢視持股的時機。
他以年末購物季比喻，消費者會在假期尋找便宜商品，投資人同樣可以尋找價格合適的標的。
隨著風險偏好回升，投資人降低對美國公債的避險需求。銅價則延續自11個月低點以來的反彈，創下1月以來最大漲幅。
油價也朝本月首度單周上漲邁進。中東能源基礎設施與油輪遭受的攻擊升級，引發市場對原油供應可能中斷的擔憂。
其他市場方面，中國官方罕見於午間發布聲明，承諾提供支持，帶動當地股市創下逾兩年來最大單日漲幅。

paras_en: US equities resumed trading on Friday (the 27th) after the Thanksgiving holiday, with all three major indices opening higher. AI‑related stocks, which had previously suffered steep losses, attracted a return of buying interest, lifting the Dow Jones Industrial Average by about 300 points. As market risk appetite improves and demand for safe‑haven US Treasuries eases, Wall Street is poised to close a turbulent week on a positive note.

The Dow is on track for its best single‑week performance since April 2025, and the S&P 500 is also poised to record its largest weekly gain since April. However, doubts remain about whether AI investments can deliver sufficient returns, and concerns over rising borrowing costs and regulatory risks have not faded, keeping the sustainability of the rebound in focus.

AI buying pressure returns, Nvidia continues to give back recent gains. AI trading warms up, pulling the Nasdaq‑100, which had been edging toward bear market territory, higher, and semiconductor sector indices rise in tandem. Yet Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is still shedding part of its recent surge, moving out of step with broader chip stocks.

In recent weeks investors have repeatedly questioned whether the massive AI spending by tech firms can translate into real earnings, putting pressure on related stocks. With buying now back in, traders are watching to see if the most intense phase of the sell‑off has passed.

Nevertheless, the price rebound has not answered the core issues of AI trading. Beyond investment returns, the market still faces higher borrowing costs, regulatory measures, and the inherent risks of AI technology itself.

Tom Essaye of The Sevens Report said the biggest takeaway from this week’s market action is that AI trading still has many unresolved problems. Until the market forms a clearer view of future developments, investors should expect volatility to continue.

Analysts see pull‑back opportunities as US Treasury safe‑haven demand cools. Brian Jacobsen of Annex Wealth Management noted that when feared scenarios fail to materialise, trades made out of fear gradually reverse and selling pressure eventually flips. Consequently, long‑term investors often view pull‑backs as a chance to reassess holdings.
He likened it to the year‑end shopping season: consumers hunt for bargains during the holidays, and investors can similarly look for attractively priced targets.
With risk appetite returning, investors are reducing their safe‑haven demand for US government bonds. Copper continues its rebound from an 11‑month low, posting its biggest gain since January.
Oil prices are also moving toward a first weekly rise this month. Escalating attacks on Middle‑East energy infrastructure and tankers have sparked concerns about possible disruptions to crude supply.
In other markets, Chinese authorities unusually issued a midday statement pledging support, spurring the local stock market to record its biggest single‑day gain in over two years.

items.title: 紐時：華為從被美國制裁 如今成為中國AI戰略的核心
items.title_en: NYT: Huawei From U.S. Sanctions to Core of China's AI Strategy
paras: 據《紐約時報》報導，在中國深圳的華為公司總部內，有一條走廊被華為高管稱為「川普走廊」，旨在紀念美國前總統川普在其第一任期內對華為發起的嚴厲打壓，並展現該公司拒絕屈服的決心。
然而，自2019年美國限制華為獲取全球無線網路設備與先進晶片以來，華為已從一家受制裁威脅生存的電信設備商，重組為北京推動人工智慧(AI)國產化的戰略核心。

從致命打擊到供應鏈轉型

美方的禁令一度對華為全球供應鏈造成重創。在制裁前，華為每年向英特爾(INTC-US)採購價值高達25億美元的晶片，並且是甲骨文(ORCL-US)與台積電(TSM-US)(2330-TW)的最大客戶之一。
2018年12月，任正非之女、華為財務長孟晚舟更應美方要求在溫哥華被捕並軟禁近三年。華為創辦人兼執行長任正非坦言：「美國制裁之後，我們的首要任務就是生存。」
面對封鎖，前美國國家安全委員會對中政策負責人托賓(Lisa Tobin)回顧表示：「我們曾以為這可能是致命一擊，事實上確實束縛了他們，打斷了他們的腿，減緩了他們的速度。但現在他們已經重整旗鼓。」中國領導人習近平對此發起本土供應鏈建設，並宣示：「現在是新的長征，我們要重新再出發。」
這場對決深刻改變了華為的內部發展路線。華為企業戰略負責人蓋剛指出：「美國政府可能還沒明白，他們這麼一打，把原來一個最親美的人打成了反美的人，」隨後他澄清任正非本人並不反美。
2021年前後，任正非加速推動本土半導體生態，與中芯國際(SMIC)及多家研究機構展開密集的半導體合作。

與輝達的技術差距與國產替代

目前，華為每年研發支出已超過270億美元，其「昇騰」系列處理器已成為中國企業替代輝達(NVDA-US)先進半導體的首選產品。華為除了設計晶片，更串聯供應商、政府支持工廠與資料中心，並與新創公司 DeepSeek 合作調校模型。
儘管如此，技術與設備壁壘依然顯著。由於荷蘭艾司摩爾(ASML)精密的極紫外光刻機受限出口，中國在半導體製造端仍面臨巨大障礙。
DeepSeek 執行長梁文鋒估計，華為目前的晶片技術大約落後輝達兩年；而隨著美方全面堵截經由海外資料中心取得晶片的管道，輝達已暫停對中國銷售。
騰訊總裁劉熾平向投資人坦言，無法取得先進輝達晶片「讓中國的所有人都倒退了」，因此當務之急必須是「加速國內半導體供應鏈的發展」。

「生存鏈條」的構築

雖然算力短期難以趕超，但華為試圖藉由結合大量性能較弱的處理器來補強系統性能，並著眼於龐大的實體工業應用。
華為正在深度配合「人工智慧+」戰略，將 AI 導入製造業。在其智慧型手機工廠內，自動化與 AI 檢查使 Mate 90 Pro 生產線的工人數從十年前的接近90人降至僅需9人。
paras_en: According to the New York Times, a corridor inside Huawei’s headquarters in Shenzhen is dubbed the “Trump Corridor” by senior executives, commemorating former U.S. President Donald Trump’s harsh crackdown on Huawei during his first term and showcasing the company’s resolve not to bow down.

However, since the United States restricted Huawei’s access to global wireless networking equipment and advanced chips in 2019, Huawei has transformed from a telecom‑equipment vendor threatened by sanctions into the strategic core of Beijing’s push for domestic AI (artificial intelligence) development.

From a lethal blow to supply‑chain transformation
The U.S. ban once dealt a severe blow to Huawei’s worldwide supply chain. Before the sanctions, Huawei purchased up to $2.5 billion worth of chips each year from Intel (INTC-US) and was one of the biggest customers of Oracle (ORCL-US) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSM-US) (2330‑TW).

In December 2018, Huawei CFO Meng Wanzhou, the daughter of founder Ren Zhengfei, was arrested in Vancouver at U.S. request and placed under house arrest for nearly three years. Founder and CEO Ren Zhengfei admitted, “After the U.S. sanctions, our top priority was survival.”

Facing the blockade, former U.S. National Security Council China‑policy lead Lisa Tobin reflected, “We thought this might be a fatal blow; it did indeed bind them, break their legs and slow them down. But now they have regrouped.” Chinese leader Xi Jinping responded by launching a domestic supply‑chain drive, declaring, “This is a new Long March; we must set out again.”

The showdown fundamentally reshaped Huawei’s internal development path. Huawei’s corporate‑strategy head Gai Gang said, “The U.S. government may not realize that by hitting them they turned someone who was once very pro‑U.S. into an anti‑U.S. figure,” then clarified that Ren Zhengfei himself is not anti‑U.S.
Around 2021, Ren Zhengfei accelerated the push for a home‑grown semiconductor ecosystem, forging intensive collaborations with SMIC (SMIC) and multiple research institutes.

Gap with Nvidia and domestic alternatives
Today Huawei spends over $27 billion a year on R&D, and its Ascend series processors have become the preferred Chinese substitute for Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) advanced semiconductors. In addition to chip design, Huawei links suppliers, government‑backed factories and data centers, and works with the startup DeepSeek to fine‑tune models.

Nevertheless, technical and equipment barriers remain significant. Because Dutch firm ASML’s (ASML) precision extreme‑ultraviolet lithography machines are subject to export restrictions, China still faces huge obstacles on the manufacturing side of semiconductors.

DeepSeek CEO Liang Wen‑feng estimates Huawei’s chip technology is about two years behind Nvidia; with the U.S. now fully blocking chip acquisition via overseas data centers, Nvidia has halted sales to China.

Tencent president Liu Chiping told investors that the inability to obtain advanced Nvidia chips “has set everyone in China back,” making it urgent to “accelerate the development of a domestic semiconductor supply chain.”

Building the “survival chain"
Although computational power cannot be overtaken in the short term, Huawei is trying to bolster system performance by combining large numbers of lower‑performance processors and focusing on massive industrial‑equipment applications.

Huawei is deeply aligning with the “AI+” strategy, embedding AI into manufacturing. In its smartphone factory, automation and AI inspection have cut the number of workers on the Mate 90 Pro production line from nearly 90 a decade ago to just nine.

items.title: 惡劣天氣夾擊美國感恩節 強風豪雨釀大停電 全美數千航班延誤取消
items.title_en: Severe Weather Hits US Thanksgiving, Strong Winds and Heavy Rain Cause Massive Power Outages, Thousands of Flights Delayed or Canceled Nationwide
paras: 美國感恩節假期遭遇罕見的惡劣天氣與高通膨雙重衝擊，自西海岸至東海岸皆受暴風雨、強風與巨浪影響，嚴重打亂民眾的佳節規劃。
東岸地區遭遇強降雨與大風襲擊，導致賓夕法尼亞州、新澤西州、維吉尼亞州及馬里蘭州等地大範圍停電，斷電用戶數一度突破百萬人。對此，賓夕法尼亞州州長Josh Shapiro表示，電力公司搶修人員正不眠不休地投入供電恢復工作。
在交通方面，美國汽車協會(AAA)預估假期期間全美將有8,150萬人出行，但惡劣天氣造成全美數千架航班延誤、數百架航班取消，公路與鐵路運輸也陷入混亂。
在紐約市，中央公園錄得有記錄以來最潮濕的感恩節，降雨量達1.82英吋(約51毫米)，紐約州與新澤西州均宣布進入緊急狀態。強風豪雨逼使標誌性的「梅西百貨感恩節大遊行」在其百年歷史中首度延期至周六舉行。
此外，美國國家氣象局(NWS)對華盛頓特區發布沿海洪水警報，並特別呼籲大眾：「請採取必要措施保護易受洪水影響的財產。若必須出行，請勿繞過路障或駛入深度不明的水域。」美國總統川普指出，正考慮釋放聯邦緊急資金以協助災後救援。
除了天災肆虐，高通膨與燃料價格居高不下也讓緊接而來的「黑色星期五」購物季蒙上陰影。美國全國零售聯合會(NRF)預計將有1.83億名消費者購物，但許多民眾直言高昂的生活成本影響了消費抉擇，計畫減少送禮人數或購買較平價的商品。
聯合會補充指出，今年有59%的消費者計畫利用人工智慧(AI)協助尋找購物推薦與比價，顯示民眾在經濟壓力下購物策略轉趨謹慎與理性。
paras_en: Thanksgiving holiday in the United States faced a rare double blow of severe weather and high inflation, with storms, strong winds and huge waves affecting the country from the West Coast to the East Coast, seriously disrupting people’s holiday plans.

The East Coast experienced heavy rain and strong winds, leading to widespread power outages in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Virginia and Maryland, with the number of customers without electricity at one point exceeding one million. Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said utility crews were working around the clock to restore power.

In terms of transportation, the American Automobile Association (AAA) estimated that 81.5 million people would travel nationwide during the holiday, but the bad weather caused thousands of flights across the United States to be delayed and hundreds to be canceled, while road and rail transport also fell into chaos.

In New York City, Central Park recorded the wettest Thanksgiving on record, with rainfall reaching 1.82 inches (about 51 mm), and both New York State and New Jersey declared a state of emergency. The iconic Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in its century‑long history, moving to Saturday due to the strong winds and heavy rain.

The National Weather Service (NWS) also issued a coastal flood warning for Washington, D.C., urging the public: “Take necessary measures to protect property vulnerable to flooding. If you must travel, do not bypass roadblocks or drive into water of unknown depth.” President Trump said the federal government is considering releasing emergency funds to aid post‑disaster relief.

Beyond the natural disaster, high inflation and soaring fuel prices have cast a shadow over the upcoming Black Friday shopping season. The National Retail Federation (NRF) expects 183 million consumers to shop, but many say the high cost of living is influencing their spending choices, with plans to give fewer gifts or buy cheaper items.

The NRF added that 59 % of consumers this year plan to use artificial intelligence (AI) to help find shopping recommendations and compare prices, indicating that shoppers are adopting more cautious and rational strategies under economic pressure.

items.title: 選前疏運運能創歷年新高 高鐵尖峰訂位近全滿、交長視察疏運狀況
paras: 2026年九合一選舉明(28)日登場，今(27)日下午起進入返鄉投票尖峰，交通部長陳世凱今日傍晚前往國道客運台北轉運站及北車高鐵(2633-TW)前進指揮所視導，檢視疏運調度及人流管理情形。
陳世凱表示，本次選舉整體疏運運能遠高於2022年地方公職人員選舉及2024年總統大選，目前高鐵及部分離島空運尖峰時段訂位已接近全滿。
陳世凱表示，疏運期間高鐵加開71班次，共開行749班次，並首度推出紅眼優惠列車；台鐵加開86列次；國道客運日均開行7,088班次，提供23.9萬個座位；國內空運提供1,010架次、約7.3萬個座位；海運提供42航次、約1.7萬個艙位，滿足民眾多元旅運需求。
針對高鐵通車近20年來首次在尖峰時段實施自由座「閘門儀控」進站管控，陳世凱也檢視排隊與放行節奏，強調人流管理必須兼顧月台安全與乘車便利，指示高鐵持續做好即時資訊告知、燈號揭露及現場引導，讓旅客候車有秩序、乘車更安心。
陳世凱也感謝高鐵的三位「捷出好友」；北捷協助人潮疏導，台中捷運及高捷加開深夜班次，銜接高鐵紅眼列車，交通部也已請相關地方政府及高鐵協調高鐵站快捷公車及排班計程車配合紅眼列車抵站時間，延後收班及加強車輛調度，確保深夜抵站旅客仍有充足的接駁服務。
陳世凱表示，今年返鄉投票需求踴躍，交通部已提前整備歷來因應選舉需求最高的疏運運能，感謝各疏運單位提前部署、相互支援，讓民眾平安返鄉、順利返程，也肯定客運團隊發揮城際運輸分流效益，提供民眾充足的旅運選擇，並責成高速公路局、公路局與國道警方密切協作，務必落實行車安全管理、壅塞熱區管控及事故快速排除。

items.title: 正崴看好明年AI高速線出貨續成長 算力中心需求旺租金有調漲空間
items.title_en: Zhengwei Optimistic About Continued Growth in AI High-Speed Cable Shipments Next Year; Strong Demand for Compute Centers Leaves Room for Rental Price Increases
paras: 正崴(2392-TW)今(27)日召開法說會，公司表示，AI伺服器相關高速傳輸線已切入美系客戶，明年營收可望持續成長；此外，旗下AI算力中心目前已達滿載，且隨租約到期後價格調整，預期相關收入還有成長空間。
正崴表示，公司於土城明權廠建置AI算力中心，採購128台搭載輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US) H100 GPU的伺服器，目前已達滿載，並以長期租賃方式提供客戶算力服務，雖然初期招租不如預期，但後續找到單一大型客戶承租逾八成算力，逐步提高使用率。
正崴進一步指出，AI算力中心現階段每月營收約3000多萬元，目前觀察市場對算力需求還是相當迫切，隨著客戶租約到期，重新議價後可望進一步提高收入，加上公司也提供軟體加值服務，預期算力中心將持續挹注營運。另外，轉投資協創數據在中國大陸經營算力業務，在當地已有相關布局及客戶基礎。
零組件事業方面，主要成長動能包括AI伺服器所需的高速傳輸線，以及AEC、AOC等產品，另外也布局AI機器人、機器狗及無人機相關線束與零組件，並持續發展低軌衛星零組件。既有產品則涵蓋耳機、手機、筆電連接器與連接線、記憶體模組及電源產品等。
正崴表示，目前AI伺服器相關產品主要供應美國客戶，營收占比不便透露，但整體表現尚可，預期明年仍將持續成長。至於美國資料中心建置可能面臨地方反對聲浪，以及美國限制中國業者租用當地算力等政策變化，公司認為，相關因素有助於提升H100算力租賃價格，對既有算力中心業務反而帶來正面效益。
系統產品方面，正崴布局AI智慧視訊會議系統，包括360度視訊設備及穿戴裝置，並持續耕耘電競、遊戲機搖桿、耳機及掌上型遊戲機等產品；此外，共享單車電動機、計程車相關模組及POS系統也是既有業務發展方向；通路事業則受惠AI帶動主機商品需求增加，加上部分客戶調漲價格，以及旗下Studio A取得學生平板標案，帶動業務成長。
機器人及機器狗也是明年重要成長動能。正崴表示，旗下新科國際布局機器狗及機器人產品，目前在台灣已有業務成長，並與相關廠商合作開發零組件。機器狗產品已取得美國市場有條件核准(Conditional Approval)，目前正積極推動FCC認證，待認證完成後，可望進一步在美國生產及銷售。
正崴指出，公司去年已在美國德州設立據點，未來可配合當地客戶需求進行生產，除機器狗整機業務外，也可供應軟板、塑膠件等相關零組件，藉此拓展美國市場及當地通路，成為明年重要的業務成長來源。
paras_en: Zhengwei (2392-TW) held its earnings briefing today (27th), stating that AI server-related high‑speed transmission cables have already entered U.S. customers and revenue is expected to keep growing next year; moreover, its AI compute center is now fully utilized and, with lease expirations and price adjustments, further revenue growth is anticipated.

Zhengwei said it has built an AI compute center at its Tucheng Mingquan plant, procuring 128 servers equipped with NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) H100 GPUs, which are now fully occupied and offered to customers via long‑term leases. Although initial leasing was slower than expected, a single large customer later took over more than 80% of the capacity, gradually raising utilization.

The company noted that the AI compute center currently generates about NT$30 million in monthly revenue. Market demand for compute power remains intense, and as leases expire and are renegotiated, income can be further lifted. In addition, Zhengwei provides software‑value‑added services, so the compute center is expected to keep feeding operations. Its investment arm, Xiechuang Data, also runs compute‑power business in mainland China with existing infrastructure and customer base there.

In the components business, main growth drivers include high‑speed transmission lines for AI servers as well as AEC and AOC products, and it is also positioning itself in wiring and components for AI robots, robot dogs and drones, while continuing development of low‑Earth‑orbit satellite parts. Existing product lines cover headphones, mobile‑phone and laptop connectors and cables, memory modules and power products, among others.

Zhengwei said its AI‑server related products are mainly supplied to U.S. customers; the revenue share was not disclosed, but overall performance is satisfactory and growth is expected to continue next year. Potential U.S. data‑center opposition and policy shifts restricting Chinese firms from renting local compute resources could actually boost H100 compute‑rental prices, bringing a positive impact to its existing compute‑center business.

In the systems segment, Zhengwei is developing AI‑enabled smart video‑conference solutions, including 360‑degree video equipment and wearables, and continues to cultivate gaming‑related products such as e‑sports gear, console controllers, headphones and handheld consoles. It also pursues electric‑motor modules for shared‑bike scooters, taxi‑related modules and POS systems as part of its established business; the distribution arm benefits from AI‑driven demand for host products, some customers raising prices, and its Studio A winning a student‑tablet contract, all driving sales growth.

Robots and robot‑dog products are another key growth engine for next year. Zhengwei’s subsidiary Xinke International is building robot‑dog and robot offerings, already seeing business growth in Taiwan and collaborating with partners on component development. The robot‑dog has obtained conditional approval in the U.S. market and is actively seeking FCC certification; once certified, it can be produced and sold in the United States.

Zhengwei highlighted that it set up a site in Texas, USA last year, which can support local customer production needs. Beyond full‑robot‑dog assemblies, the site can also supply flex‑circuits, plastic parts and other related components, helping expand its U.S. market presence and distribution channels, and becoming a major source of business growth next year.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉築底訊號出現？估房市將逐步止跌回穩 明年房貸穩健成長5%
items.title_en: First Financial Holding’s Earnings Talk: Bottoming Signal Appears? Housing Market Expected to Gradually Stabilize Next Year, Mortgage Growth Forecast at 5%
paras: 第一金控 (2892-TW) 今（27）日於線上法說會表示，國內六都買賣移轉棟數年增率在10月已由負轉正，顯示房市交易量出現初步回溫跡象。展望明年，在首購自住剛性需求與新青安3.0政策支撐下，明年房市交易量可望逐步止跌回穩，一銀明年房貸業務預估將維持4%至5%的穩健成長，同時銀行整體放款目標成長5%至6%，中小企業放款與財富管理手續費收入則分別拚增10%與15%。
觀察近期房市脈動，一銀副總朱芙蓉指出，今年前9月六都買賣移轉棟數年增率為負0.2%，但10月單月年增率已翻正至0.23%，呈現初步築底回穩訊號。由於央行在今年第3季適度放寬選擇性信用管制，將第二戶購屋貸款成數上限由6成調高至7成，有助於改善市場信心與換屋族資金彈性，不過整體信用管制尚未全面鬆綁，加上銀行資金仍偏緊俏，預期明年房市交易動能將呈現量縮盤整格局，但成交量有機會較今年溫和回升。
在房貸業務策略上，朱芙蓉強調目前承作的房貸客群主要聚焦於首購族等自住剛性需求。隨著國內經濟與就業市場保持穩定，加上新青安3.0優惠方案上路，有效惠及首購、新婚與育兒族群，為剛性購屋需求提供有力支撐。第一金未來將依市場狀況滾動調整授信方向，預估明年整體房貸業務將呈現中性穩健的成長態勢，全年房貸餘額成長率目標設定在4%至5%區間。

paras_en: First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) said in its online earnings briefing today (27th) that the year‑over‑year growth rate of transaction units in the six major cities turned positive in October, indicating an initial warming of housing market activity. Looking ahead to next year, driven by the rigid demand for first‑time home purchases and the New Youth Housing 3.0 policy, transaction volume is expected to gradually stop falling and stabilize. The bank projects mortgage business to grow steadily by 4%‑5% next year, while overall loan growth is targeted at 5%‑6%, with SME lending and wealth‑management fee income each aiming for 10% and 15% increases respectively.

Observing recent market trends, Deputy General Manager Zhu Furong noted that the year‑over‑year growth rate of transaction units in the six major cities was –0.2% for the first nine months of this year, but turned positive to 0.23% in October, showing an early bottom‑building signal. Because the central bank moderately eased selective credit controls in Q3, raising the loan‑to‑value cap for second‑home purchases from 60% to 70%, market confidence and funding flexibility for house‑hoppers improve. However, overall credit controls remain in place and bank funding is still relatively tight, so the market is expected to see a volume‑contraction consolidation pattern next year, with transaction volume likely to recover modestly compared with this year.

On mortgage strategy, Zhu emphasized that the bank’s current mortgage clientele mainly focuses on first‑time buyers and other owner‑occupier demand. With the domestic economy and employment staying stable and the rollout of the New Youth Housing 3.0 incentives benefiting first‑time buyers, newlyweds and families with children, rigid home‑buying demand receives strong support. First Financial will adjust its credit allocation as market conditions evolve and expects overall mortgage business to grow neutrally and steadily next year, targeting a 4%‑5% increase in total mortgage balances.

Regarding the bank’s overall credit and fee‑income plan for next year, given continued macro‑economic uncertainty, First Financial sets a total loan‑growth target of 5%‑6%. To optimise the credit mix and improve net interest margins, the bank will actively push SME lending, forecasting a 10% growth rate for SME loans next year. On the fee side, after a 30% surge in wealth‑management fees this year, the bank aims for a double‑digit 15% growth in wealth‑management fee income next year, which should lift overall fee income by 12%.

In addition, facing competition in profitability and stock performance, Zhu admitted that the bank’s securities subsidiary, being relatively small, benefited only modestly from the bullish Taiwan stock market this year, and the life‑insurance subsidiary is still expanding. To strengthen long‑term competitiveness, First Financial will leverage resource sharing and integrated marketing between its banking and securities arms, actively channel banking customers to securities, consider capital‑raising plans for the securities and life‑insurance units, and intensify promotion of protection‑type and investment‑type policies to build contract‑service margins, fully expanding its dual‑engine model to reach new operational peaks.

items.title: 馬斯克預言：Optimus機器人18個月內包辦家務 人人會想買一至兩台
items.title_en: Musk Predicts Optimus Robots Will Handle Household Chores Within 18 Months, Everyone Will Want One or Two
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)預言，旗下 Optimus 人形機器人預計在大約一年至一年半(12 到 18 個月)內，即可具備洗碗與倒垃圾等日常家務處理能力。馬斯克更樂觀表示，一旦機器人成功掌握這些家務技能，「幾乎所有人都會想要一台，甚至兩台」。
這項展望是馬斯克於 11 月 18 日出席 TomorrowX 峰會時所發表。當時，阿特雷迪斯管理公司(Atreides Management)首席投資官Gavin Baker在會中提出疑問，並坦言自己平時非常不喜歡倒垃圾或洗碗。針對貝克提出的家務痛點，馬斯克回應指出，Optimus 機器人在 12 至 18 個月內就能夠實現貝克所描述的家務處理能力。
馬斯克坦言，目前人形機器人雖然已經能夠在舞台上表演跳舞，甚至流暢做出後空翻等高難度動作，但若要把餐盤上乾涸的剩菜殘渣刮乾淨，對機器人而言完全是另一項挑戰。
儘管如此，特斯拉團隊評估 Optimus 機器人距離真正解決這項家務考驗，僅需大約一年到一年半的時間。
馬斯克強調，一旦 Optimus 能突破技術難關並幫忙處理洗碗與倒垃圾等居家瑣事，市場需求將會相當驚人，屆時幾乎每個人都會想要購入一台、甚至是兩台機器人來協助日常生活。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk forecast that its Optimus humanoid robot will be capable of everyday chores such as washing dishes and taking out the trash within roughly a year to a year and a half (12 to 18 months). Musk added that once the robot masters these tasks, “almost everyone will want one, maybe even two.”

He made this projection while speaking at the TomorrowX summit on November 18. During the event, Atreides Management’s chief investment officer Gavin Baker raised a question, admitting he personally dislikes taking out the trash or washing dishes. In response to Baker’s pain point, Musk said the Optimus robot could achieve the described household‑task capability within 12 to 18 months.

Musk acknowledged that although humanoid robots can already perform on‑stage dances and even execute complex moves like backflips, scraping dried food residue off a plate is an entirely different challenge for the machines.
Nevertheless, the Tesla team estimates that solving this household‑task hurdle will take roughly one to one and a half years for the Optimus robot.

Musk emphasized that once Optimus overcomes the technical barrier and can handle dishwashing and trash‑taking, market demand will be astonishing, with virtually everyone wanting to purchase one—or even two—robots to assist with daily life.

items.title: 選前疏運運能創歷年新高 高鐵尖峰訂位近全滿、交長視察疏運狀況
paras: 2026年九合一選舉明(28)日登場，今(27)日下午起進入返鄉投票尖峰，交通部長陳世凱今日傍晚前往國道客運台北轉運站及北車高鐵(2633-TW)前進指揮所視導，檢視疏運調度及人流管理情形。
陳世凱表示，本次選舉整體疏運運能遠高於2022年地方公職人員選舉及2024年總統大選，目前高鐵及部分離島空運尖峰時段訂位已接近全滿。
陳世凱表示，疏運期間高鐵加開71班次，共開行749班次，並首度推出紅眼優惠列車；台鐵加開86列次；國道客運日均開行7,088班次，提供23.9萬個座位；國內空運提供1,010架次、約7.3萬個座位；海運提供42航次、約1.7萬個艙位，滿足民眾多元旅運需求。
針對高鐵通車近20年來首次在尖峰時段實施自由座「閘門儀控」進站管控，陳世凱也檢視排隊與放行節奏，強調人流管理必須兼顧月台安全與乘車便利，指示高鐵持續做好即時資訊告知、燈號揭露及現場引導，讓旅客候車有秩序、乘車更安心。
陳世凱也感謝高鐵的三位「捷出好友」；北捷協助人潮疏導，台中捷運及高捷加開深夜班次，銜接高鐵紅眼列車，交通部也已請相關地方政府及高鐵協調高鐵站快捷公車及排班計程車配合紅眼列車抵站時間，延後收班及加強車輛調度，確保深夜抵站旅客仍有充足的接駁服務。
陳世凱表示，今年返鄉投票需求踴躍，交通部已提前整備歷來因應選舉需求最高的疏運運能，感謝各疏運單位提前部署、相互支援，讓民眾平安返鄉、順利返程，也肯定客運團隊發揮城際運輸分流效益，提供民眾充足的旅運選擇，並責成高速公路局、公路局與國道警方密切協作，務必落實行車安全管理、壅塞熱區管控及事故快速排除。

items.title: 正崴看好明年AI高速線出貨續成長 算力中心需求旺租金有調漲空間
items.title_en: Zhengwei Optimistic About Continued Growth in AI High-Speed Cable Shipments Next Year; Strong Demand for Compute Centers Leaves Room for Rental Price Increases
paras: 正崴(2392-TW)今(27)日召開法說會，公司表示，AI伺服器相關高速傳輸線已切入美系客戶，明年營收可望持續成長；此外，旗下AI算力中心目前已達滿載，且隨租約到期後價格調整，預期相關收入還有成長空間。
正崴表示，公司於土城明權廠建置AI算力中心，採購128台搭載輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US) H100 GPU的伺服器，目前已達滿載，並以長期租賃方式提供客戶算力服務，雖然初期招租不如預期，但後續找到單一大型客戶承租逾八成算力，逐步提高使用率。
正崴進一步指出，AI算力中心現階段每月營收約3000多萬元，目前觀察市場對算力需求還是相當迫切，隨著客戶租約到期，重新議價後可望進一步提高收入，加上公司也提供軟體加值服務，預期算力中心將持續挹注營運。另外，轉投資協創數據在中國大陸經營算力業務，在當地已有相關布局及客戶基礎。
零組件事業方面，主要成長動能包括AI伺服器所需的高速傳輸線，以及AEC、AOC等產品，另外也布局AI機器人、機器狗及無人機相關線束與零組件，並持續發展低軌衛星零組件。既有產品則涵蓋耳機、手機、筆電連接器與連接線、記憶體模組及電源產品等。
正崴表示，目前AI伺服器相關產品主要供應美國客戶，營收占比不便透露，但整體表現尚可，預期明年仍將持續成長。至於美國資料中心建置可能面臨地方反對聲浪，以及美國限制中國業者租用當地算力等政策變化，公司認為，相關因素有助於提升H100算力租賃價格，對既有算力中心業務反而帶來正面效益。
系統產品方面，正崴布局AI智慧視訊會議系統，包括360度視訊設備及穿戴裝置，並持續耕耘電競、遊戲機搖桿、耳機及掌上型遊戲機等產品；此外，共享單車電動機、計程車相關模組及POS系統也是既有業務發展方向；通路事業則受惠AI帶動主機商品需求增加，加上部分客戶調漲價格，以及旗下Studio A取得學生平板標案，帶動業務成長。
機器人及機器狗也是明年重要成長動能。正崴表示，旗下新科國際布局機器狗及機器人產品，目前在台灣已有業務成長，並與相關廠商合作開發零組件。機器狗產品已取得美國市場有條件核准(Conditional Approval)，目前正積極推動FCC認證，待認證完成後，可望進一步在美國生產及銷售。
正崴指出，公司去年已在美國德州設立據點，未來可配合當地客戶需求進行生產，除機器狗整機業務外，也可供應軟板、塑膠件等相關零組件，藉此拓展美國市場及當地通路，成為明年重要的業務成長來源。
paras_en: Zhengwei (2392-TW) held its earnings briefing today (27th), stating that AI server-related high‑speed transmission cables have already entered U.S. customers and revenue is expected to keep growing next year; moreover, its AI compute center is now fully utilized and, with lease expirations and price adjustments, further revenue growth is anticipated.

Zhengwei said it has built an AI compute center at its Tucheng Mingquan plant, procuring 128 servers equipped with NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) H100 GPUs, which are now fully occupied and offered to customers via long‑term leases. Although initial leasing was slower than expected, a single large customer later took over more than 80% of the capacity, gradually raising utilization.

The company noted that the AI compute center currently generates about NT$30 million in monthly revenue. Market demand for compute power remains intense, and as leases expire and are renegotiated, income can be further lifted. In addition, Zhengwei provides software‑value‑added services, so the compute center is expected to keep feeding operations. Its investment arm, Xiechuang Data, also runs compute‑power business in mainland China with existing infrastructure and customer base there.

In the components business, main growth drivers include high‑speed transmission lines for AI servers as well as AEC and AOC products, and it is also positioning itself in wiring and components for AI robots, robot dogs and drones, while continuing development of low‑Earth‑orbit satellite parts. Existing product lines cover headphones, mobile‑phone and laptop connectors and cables, memory modules and power products, among others.

Zhengwei said its AI‑server related products are mainly supplied to U.S. customers; the revenue share was not disclosed, but overall performance is satisfactory and growth is expected to continue next year. Potential U.S. data‑center opposition and policy shifts restricting Chinese firms from renting local compute resources could actually boost H100 compute‑rental prices, bringing a positive impact to its existing compute‑center business.

In the systems segment, Zhengwei is developing AI‑enabled smart video‑conference solutions, including 360‑degree video equipment and wearables, and continues to cultivate gaming‑related products such as e‑sports gear, console controllers, headphones and handheld consoles. It also pursues electric‑motor modules for shared‑bike scooters, taxi‑related modules and POS systems as part of its established business; the distribution arm benefits from AI‑driven demand for host products, some customers raising prices, and its Studio A winning a student‑tablet contract, all driving sales growth.

Robots and robot‑dog products are another key growth engine for next year. Zhengwei’s subsidiary Xinke International is building robot‑dog and robot offerings, already seeing business growth in Taiwan and collaborating with partners on component development. The robot‑dog has obtained conditional approval in the U.S. market and is actively seeking FCC certification; once certified, it can be produced and sold in the United States.

Zhengwei highlighted that it set up a site in Texas, USA last year, which can support local customer production needs. Beyond full‑robot‑dog assemblies, the site can also supply flex‑circuits, plastic parts and other related components, helping expand its U.S. market presence and distribution channels, and becoming a major source of business growth next year.

First Financial will adjust its credit allocation as market conditions evolve and expects overall mortgage business to grow neutrally and steadily next year, targeting a 4%‑5% increase in total mortgage balances.

Regarding the bank’s overall credit and fee‑income plan for next year, given continued macro‑economic uncertainty, First Financial sets a total loan‑growth target of 5%‑6%. To optimise the credit mix and improve net interest margins, the bank will actively push SME lending, forecasting a 10% growth rate for SME loans next year. On the fee side, after a 30% surge in wealth‑management fees this year, the bank aims for a double‑digit 15% growth in wealth‑management fee income next year, which should lift overall fee income by 12%.

In addition, facing competition in profitability and stock performance, Zhu admitted that the bank’s securities subsidiary, being relatively small, benefited only modestly from the bullish Taiwan stock market this year, and the life‑insurance subsidiary is still expanding. To strengthen long‑term competitiveness, First Financial will leverage resource sharing and integrated marketing between its banking and securities arms, actively channel banking customers to securities, consider capital‑raising plans for the securities and life‑insurance units, and intensify promotion of protection‑type and investment‑type policies to build contract‑service margins, fully expanding its dual‑engine model to reach new operational peaks.

items.title: 眾達-KY自結10月EPS淨損0.46元 單月虧損3200萬元
items.title_en: Zhongda‑KY posts October EPS net loss of NT$0.46 per share, monthly loss of NT$32 million
paras: 光收發模廠眾達-KY(4977-TW)近期股價震盪劇烈，有價證券達主管機關要求，公布注意交易資訊標準，眾達-KY今(27)日盤後也自結財務訊息，以利投資人區別瞭解。眾達-KY自結上(10)月單月稅後淨損為3,200萬元，較去(2025)年同期盈轉虧，每股淨損0.46元，今(2026)年第3季稅後純益2.36億元、年增194.11%，EPS為2.84元。
眾達-KY今年第3季營運大躍升，因受惠今年5月起納入品固集團營收之下，單季營收季增1.79倍、毛利率也翻倍衝上47.44%，累計前3季稅後純益3.56億元、年增28%，EPS 4.39元。
眾達-KY專注於高速光收發模組的研發與製造，目前關注焦點主要集中在400G、800G等高階產品的出貨進度，加上公司在雷射光學封裝領域與博通(AVGO-US)的合作布局，相關產品布局，也成為觀察高速光通訊產業升級的重要指標。
法人指出，眾達-KY今年併購品固集團後，也跨足高精密塑膠及金屬等領域，優化現有產品設計與成本結構，使公司高附加價值之客製化光通訊產品能結合，以提升其他領域供應鏈的各層級客戶，公司自2021年起便與博通合作開發CPO技術，核心產品包括光引擎與外置雷射光源模組。
眾達今日股價受光通訊一片慘綠影響，開高走低終場重挫7.42%收131元，自11月18日波段高點197元算，股價已大跌超過30%以上。
paras_en: Zhongda‑KY (4977‑TW), a maker of optical transceiver modules, has seen its share price swing wildly recently. In response to a securities regulator’s request to publish trading‑information standards, the company released post‑month financial data after market close on the 27th to help investors understand the situation. Zhongda‑KY reported a net loss after tax of NT$32 million for October, turning a profit in the same month of 2025 into a loss, amounting to a loss of NT$0.46 per share. For the third quarter of 2026, it posted a net profit after tax of NT$2.36 billion, up 194.11% year‑over‑year, with an EPS of NT$2.84.

In the third quarter of this year, Zhongda‑KY’s operations surged, benefitting from the inclusion of Pin‑Gu Group’s revenue since May. Quarterly revenue grew 1.79 times sequentially and gross margin doubled to 47.44%. Cumulatively for the first three quarters, net profit after tax reached NT$3.56 billion, a 28% year‑over‑year increase, and EPS was NT$4.39.

Zhongda‑KY focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of high‑speed optical transceiver modules, currently concentrating on the shipment progress of high‑end products such as 400G and 800G. The company’s collaborations in laser‑optics packaging with Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and related product deployments have become key indicators for tracking the upgrade of the high‑speed optical communications industry.

Analysts note that after acquiring Pin‑Gu Group this year, Zhongda‑KY has also entered high‑precision plastic and metal sectors, optimizing existing product designs and cost structures. This enables the company’s high‑value‑added, customized optical communication products to integrate with and enhance supply‑chain customers across other fields. Since 2021, the firm has worked with Broadcom on CPO technology development, with core products including optical engines and external laser source modules.

Zhongda’s stock price was hit hard by a broadly gloomy outlook for optical communications, opening higher but falling throughout the session to close down 7.42% at NT$131. From the November 18 peak of NT$197, the share price has dropped more than 30%.

items.title: 鴻海大語言模型FoxBrain 臺灣主權AI評測奪全球第二
items.title_en: Hon Hai's Large Language Model FoxBrain Ranks Second Globally in Taiwan Sovereign AI Evaluation
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)持續深化AI布局，旗下鴻海研究院自主研發的大型語言模型FoxBrain v2.1，在數位發展部「AI產品與系統評測中心」（AIEC）的「臺灣主權AI基礎評測指標」中，依目前彙整資料排名全球第二。該模型具備31B參數規模，可部署於單台AI伺服器，也讓鴻海AI布局從硬體製造進一步延伸至模型研發與企業端應用。
FoxBrain v2.1此次在國學素養、公民素養及臺灣核心價值觀三項指標的正確率，分別達96.20%、91.37%及98%。其中，臺灣核心價值觀正確率高於目前彙整名單中的所有國際模型；國文科與社會科表現，也分別較其他國內模型最佳成績高約9.4及4.2個百分點。
AIEC評測自2025年3月啟動，持續針對國內外語言模型進行基準測試，並於同年10月首度公布42個模型的評測結果，涵蓋學測國文、學測社會及臺灣核心價值觀三大指標。
在商業應用方面，FoxBrain v2.1參數規模為31B，可在符合硬體及推論設定需求的單台AI伺服器部署，提供企業在自有環境運行模型的選項。相較其他前瞻模型，鴻海指出，FoxBrain僅以約十分之一至百分之一的參數量，即取得AIEC全球第二的成績，凸顯模型在參數效率及繁體中文資料處理方面的研發成果。
鴻海研究院人工智慧研究所所長栗永徽表示，FoxBrain研發重點在於資料建構、模型訓練與對齊，以及符合產業需求的深度推理能力，此次評測讓團隊能透過具體指標檢視研發成果，並與國際模型在相同評測範圍內比較。
鴻海研究院表示，研發過程中自主建構繁體中文資料，並整合模型訓練、對齊及評測，建立從資料建構到模型驗證的完整流程，持續深化資料取得、資料治理及模型調參等核心技術。
對鴻海而言，FoxBrain的進展也反映集團AI技術布局不僅著眼於AI伺服器製造，也逐步向模型及軟體技術延伸，未來可望提供企業更多元的AI部署選擇。不過，現階段公布的評測成績主要反映特定題組與測試條件下的表現，尚不能直接視為模型在各類產業應用的實際效能。
paras_en: Hon Hai (2317‑TW) continues to deepen its AI footprint. Its in‑house large language model FoxBrain v2.1, developed by the Hon Hai Research Institute, ranked second worldwide in the Ministry of Digital Development’s “AI Product and System Evaluation Center” (AIEC) “Taiwan Sovereign AI Baseline Evaluation Index,” based on the data compiled so far. The model has 31 billion parameters and can be deployed on a single AI server, extending Hon Hai’s AI strategy from hardware manufacturing to model development and enterprise applications.

In this evaluation, FoxBrain v2.1 achieved accuracy rates of 96.20% in Chinese classics literacy, 91.37% in civic literacy, and 98% in Taiwan core values. Its accuracy on Taiwan core values surpasses all international models in the current list, while its performance in Chinese language and social studies exceeds the best domestic models by roughly 9.4 and 4.2 percentage points respectively.

The AIEC testing program began in March 2025, continuously benchmarking domestic and foreign language models. In October of the same year it released the first set of results for 42 models, covering three major indicators: the college entrance Chinese language test, the college entrance social studies test, and Taiwan core values.

For commercial use, FoxBrain v2.1’s 31 billion‑parameter size can be run on a single AI server that meets the required hardware and inference settings, giving enterprises the option to operate the model in their own environments. Compared with other forward‑looking models, Hon Hai notes that FoxBrain achieved the global second place with only about one‑tenth to one‑hundredth of the parameter count, highlighting its efficiency and its research achievements in handling Traditional Chinese data.

Dr. Li Yong‑hui, director of the Institute of Artificial Intelligence at Hon Hai Research Institute, said the development focus of FoxBrain is on data construction, model training and alignment, and deep reasoning capabilities that meet industry needs. This evaluation allowed the team to assess their results with concrete metrics and compare the model against international peers under the same test scope.

Hon Hai Research Institute stated that during development it independently built Traditional Chinese datasets and integrated model training, alignment, and evaluation, establishing a complete workflow from data construction to model verification, and continues to deepen core technologies such as data acquisition, data governance, and model tuning.

For Hon Hai, FoxBrain’s progress reflects the group’s AI strategy that not only targets AI server manufacturing but also gradually expands into model and software technologies, promising more diversified AI deployment options for enterprises in the future. However, the published scores currently reflect performance on specific question sets and test conditions and should not be taken as direct evidence of the model’s real‑world effectiveness across all industry applications.

items.title: 〈第一金法說〉央行年底升息？一銀估台灣按兵不動 惟Fed明年Q1前有望升息2次
items.title_en: First Financial Holding’s Earnings Call: Will the Central Bank Raise Rates at Year‑End? Bank of Taiwan Expects No Change, Yet Fed May Hike Twice Before Q1 2025
paras: 針對明年全球總體經濟與台美央行利率走向，第一金控 (2892-TW)今在線上法說會指出，雖有地緣政治與能源價格波動干擾，明年全球經濟成長率仍將維持3.4%，台灣明年經濟成長率亦可望穩守6%大關。一銀副總經理廖文偉預期美國聯準會今年12月及明年3月前仍有各升息1碼的空間，而台灣央行12月雖以維持利率不變為基準情境，但若台美利差持續擴大引發輸入性通膨壓力，仍不排除有跟進升息的可能。
分析全球景氣動向，第一金研究團隊指出，今年雖有中東戰事等衝突影響能源供應，但受惠於企業對人工智慧、高效能運算及雲端服務的強勁投資，加上家庭可支配所得具備緩衝支撐，今年全球經濟成長率預估為3.3%。
展望明年，地緣政治與能源市場的干擾將逐步消化，人工智慧相關資本支出持續支撐復甦，預期全球經濟擴張步伐將更為平穩，全年經濟成長率可望微幅上揚至3.4%。
聚焦台灣經濟表現，受惠於人工智慧應用成長與半導體供應鏈需求強勁，帶動出口與外銷訂單暢旺，加上民間投資持續擴張，今年台灣經濟成長率已突破12%。考量今年基期大幅墊高，明年經濟成長率雖會自然收斂，但在薪資提升與就業市場穩定的支撐下，民間消費動能可望維持溫和穩健，預估明年台灣經濟成長率仍將有6%左右的亮眼表現，整體景氣維持正成長軌道。
在備受市場關注的美國聯準會利率決策上，廖文偉認為聯準會今年12月再度升息1碼的機率相當高，且在明年3月之前，仍不排除有再升息1碼的空間，整體貨幣政策路徑與目前市場主流共識相符。由於美國維持高利率環境的時間拉長，台美利差預計將會進一步往外擴大，這不僅為銀行業的換匯交易操作帶來正向收益空間，也成為影響新台幣匯率與國內貨幣政策的重要變數。
至於台灣央行的利率動向，廖文偉指出，考量目前廣義貨幣總計數年增率仍低於名目經濟成長率，基本情境下預期央行12月理監事會議將維持政策利率按兵不動。然而，若未來美元持續走強，加上台美利差擴大導致新台幣匯率承壓，進而引發輸入性通膨升溫的風險，台灣央行在政策考量上仍會保留彈性，不排除有採取升息措施的可能性，經營團隊將持續密切追蹤國際金融市場變化。
paras_en: Regarding next year’s global macro‑economy and the interest‑rate trajectories of the Taiwan and U.S. central banks, First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) said in today’s online earnings briefing that despite geopolitical tensions and energy‑price volatility, the world’s growth rate is expected to stay at 3.4% in 2024 and Taiwan’s economy should hold steady at the 6% mark. Bank of Taiwan Deputy General Manager Liao Wen‑wei forecasts that the U.S. Federal Reserve could still raise rates by one basis point in December 2024 and again before March 2025, while the Taiwan central bank is likely to keep rates unchanged in December unless the widening Taiwan‑U.S. rate gap fuels imported‑inflation pressures, in which case a hike cannot be ruled out.

Analyzing global economic trends, First Financial’s research team noted that although Middle‑East conflicts have disrupted energy supplies this year, strong corporate investment in artificial intelligence, high‑performance computing and cloud services, together with household disposable income providing a buffer, lead them to project a global growth rate of 3.3% for 2023.

Looking ahead to next year, they expect the geopolitical and energy‑market disruptions to be gradually absorbed, with AI‑related capital spending continuing to support the recovery. Consequently, the pace of global expansion should become smoother, and the annual growth rate could edge up modestly to 3.4% in 2024.

Focusing on Taiwan’s performance, the surge in AI applications and robust demand in the semiconductor supply chain have boosted exports and overseas orders, while private investment remains strong, pushing this year’s growth rate past 12%. Given the unusually high base effect, growth will naturally moderate next year, but higher wages and a stable job market should keep consumer momentum moderate yet steady, leading to an estimated 6% growth for 2024 and keeping the overall economy on a positive trajectory.

On the much‑watched U.S. Fed rate decisions, Liao Wen‑wei believes the probability of another one‑point hike in December 2024 is high, and a further one‑point increase before March 2025 cannot be excluded, aligning with the prevailing market consensus on the monetary‑policy path. A prolonged high‑rate environment in the U.S. will likely widen the Taiwan‑U.S. spread, creating upside potential for banks’ foreign‑exchange trading profits and becoming a key factor influencing the New Taiwan dollar and domestic policy.

Regarding Taiwan’s central‑bank policy, Liao notes that because the multi‑year growth rate of broad money remains below nominal GDP growth, the baseline expectation is that the December policy‑rate meeting will keep rates unchanged. However, if the dollar stays strong and the Taiwan‑U.S. spread widens, putting pressure on the NT$ and raising imported‑inflation risks, the central bank retains flexibility and may consider a hike; the management team will continue to monitor international financial‑market developments closely.

items.title: 友達華亞廠找到新買家 售予矽品處分利益估104億元
items.title_en: AU Optronics' Huaya Plant Finds New Buyer, Sale to Siliconware Estimates NT$10.4 Billion Profit
paras: 面板大廠友達(2409-TW)今(27)日公告，董事會決議處分桃園華亞廠不動產及相關廠務附屬設施，交易對象為日月光投控(3711-TW)旗下矽品，交易金額197億元，預計處分利益估約104億元。
友達7月底董事會通過出售華亞廠予廣達電腦(2382-TW)，但因雙方對廠房使用規格及交付時程未能達成協議，董事會於10月底決議終止處分案，並另覓買家，今日公告新買家為矽品。
友達此次處分標的包括桃園市龜山區華亞段2筆土地及8筆建物，土地面積約1萬9,741坪、建物面積約4萬9,255坪，另包含相關廠務附屬設施，處分利益約104億元，已扣除相關交易費用及預估稅費。
友達董事長彭双浪先前指出，目前廠房空間已達合適狀態，資產活化將告一段落，未來廠房處分回收資金將作為策略性及未來性投資用途，配合既有三大營運支柱及創新研究院的技術布局，兼顧短中期營運成長與長期技術競爭力。
paras_en: AU Optronics (2409‑TW) announced today (27th) that its board has approved the disposal of the Huaya plant in Taoyuan, including real estate and related ancillary facilities, to Siliconware, a subsidiary of Sunlight Group (3711‑TW). The transaction value is NT$197 billion, with an expected disposal profit of about NT$10.4 billion.

At the end of July, AU Optronics' board approved the sale of the Huaya plant to Quanta Computer (2382‑TW), but the parties could not agree on plant usage specifications and delivery schedule. The board therefore resolved at the end of October to terminate that deal and seek another buyer; today it announced Siliconware as the new purchaser.

The assets being sold comprise two parcels of land in the Huaya section of Guishan District, Taoyuan City, and eight buildings, totaling roughly 19,741 ping of land and 49,255 ping of building area, together with related plant ancillary facilities. The disposal profit is estimated at about NT$10.4 billion after deducting transaction costs and estimated taxes.

Chairman Peng Shuang‑lang previously noted that the plant’s space utilization is now appropriate, marking the end of the asset activation phase. The proceeds from the plant sale will be used for strategic and future‑oriented investments, aligning with the company’s three core operating pillars and the technology layout of its Innovation Research Institute, to support short‑ and medium‑term operational growth as well as long‑term technological competitiveness.

items.title: 〈航運指數〉歐洲線運價強彈 SCFI止跌 航商力拚年約價漲
items.title_en: Shipping Index: European Route Rates Bounce Strongly as SCFI Halts Decline, Carriers Push for Slight Annual Rate Increase
paras: 上海航交所今(27)日公布最新一期上海出口集裝箱運價指數(SCFI)，終結連3周下跌，反彈65.76點至3569.54點，周漲1.88%，儘管美國線運價續弱，反映相對淡季，但歐洲線強彈，航商力拚即將簽訂的歐洲年約運價可小幅上漲。
本周主要航線中，遠東到歐洲每FEU(標準40呎櫃)大漲389美元至3745美元，彈幅多達11.59%；遠東到地中海每FEU更是狂飆893美元至5764美元，彈幅高達18.33%。
遠東到美西每FEU運價續跌354美元至6357美元，跌幅5.27%，遠東到美東每FEU跌514美元，來到8262美元，跌幅5.86%，反映價格衝高後的淡季修正。
目前美西航線運價約7000-7700美元，美東航線約9000美元，均較上周上修，而歐洲航線運價約3000-3500美元，供應鏈瓶頸令供給相對有限、運價淡季有撐。
貨攬業者提醒，歐洲線部分航次雖有 3500美元以下的特價，但目前航商力拚歐洲年約運價可小幅上漲，觀察12月中旬後新年度合約的議價和簽約情況。
paras_en: The Shanghai Shipping Exchange released the latest Shanghai Export Container Freight Index (SCFI) today (27th), ending three weeks of decline with a rebound of 65.76 points to 3,569.54, up 1.88% for the week. Despite continued weakness in U.S. routes reflecting a relatively off‑peak season, European routes surged, and carriers are striving to achieve a modest increase in the upcoming European annual contract rates.

Among the main routes this week, Far East to Europe rose sharply by $389 per FEU (standard 40‑foot container) to $3,745, a jump of 11.59%; Far East to the Mediterranean surged even more, climbing $893 per FEU to $5,764, an increase of 18.33%.

Far East to the U.S. West Coast continued to fall, down $354 per FEU to $6,357, a decline of 5.27%, while Far East to the U.S. East Coast dropped $514 per FEU to $8,262, a 5.86% decrease, reflecting a seasonal correction after price peaks.

Current rates are roughly $7,000‑$7,700 for the West Coast route and about $9,000 for the East Coast route, both revised upward from last week, while European route rates sit around $3,000‑$3,500, with supply‑chain bottlenecks limiting supply and supporting off‑peak pricing.

Freight forwarders note that some European sailings still offer special rates below $3,500, but carriers are pushing for a slight increase in European annual contract rates and will monitor pricing and signing activity for new contracts after mid‑December.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉AI強勢回血！標普創2025年4月來最佳單周 Sandisk飆16% Anthropic重返IPO價
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks After Hours: AI Leads Strong Recovery, S&P Posts Best Weekly Gain Since April 2025, Sandisk Jumps 16%, Anthropic Returns to IPO Price
paras: 人工智慧(AI)股吹起反彈號角，幫助美股主要指數周五(27日)全面收高，結束這個劇烈波動且因假期縮短的一周。道瓊一周來上漲近600點，創2022年來最大單周漲點，標普500指數也締造2025年4月以來最佳單周表現。
美股周四因感恩節休市一天，周五雖然恢復交易，但提早收盤。
本月遭投資人重挫的晶片股收復近期部分失土，美光(MU-US)與邁威爾)(Marvell)(MRVL-US)周五分別上漲7.6%及7.3%。 AI受惠股也大幅走高，資料儲存業者Sandisk(SNDK-US)股價飆漲近16%，光學產品製造商Lumentum(LITE-US)及伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)分別勁揚8%和6.7%。
營運大型資料中心的大型AI雲端業者(Hyperscalers)，包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、Meta Platforms(META-US)及甲骨文(ORCL-US)，股價全面上漲。
川普周四坦承，近期市場動盪一度讓他感到擔憂。這波震盪格外劇烈，是數月來籠罩華爾街的市場波動進一步升高的表現，反映AI熱潮背後的金融與經濟利害關係日益重大。
本周稍早公布的數據顯示，美國經濟第3季成長速度遠高於初估，10月通膨也進一步加速。交易員幾乎完全押注聯準會(Fed)將在12月升息。
本周道瓊工業指數上漲5.46%，標普500指數上漲5.6%，那斯達克指數上漲6.68%，使三大指數創下2008年以來最佳感恩節周的表現。當時正逢金融危機期間，三大指數當年周漲幅各為9.7%、12%、10.9%。
不過本周的反彈仍不足以收復11月以來的跌幅，標普500指數與那斯達克指數恐交出2008年以來最差11月表現。市場擔憂民主黨贏得美國期中選舉後，AI監管可能趨嚴，加上貨幣政策預料將持續緊縮，都對股市構成壓力。
美股周五(27日)主要指數表現：

道瓊工業指數上漲591.99點，或1.18%，收50,774.94點。
那斯達克綜合指數上漲543.70點，或2.31%，收24,129.50點。
標普500指數上漲114.71點，或1.60%，收7,297.49點。
費城半導體指數上漲411.84點，或4.69%，收9,186.71點。
NYSE FANG+ 指數上漲452.98點，或2.82%，收16,510.93點。


標普11大類股中全數上漲，基本金屬、科技類股漲最多。

焦點個股

NYSE FANG + 指數中的科技五大巨頭多上揚。Meta(META-US)上漲3.13%；蘋果(AAPL-US)上漲0.83%；Alphabet(GOOGL-US)下跌0.68%；微軟(MSFT-US)上漲0.60%；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)上漲3.96%。
費半成分股幾乎全面上漲。Coherent(COHR-US)飆逾14%，美光(MU-US)大漲7.6%，邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)漲7.3%，英特爾(INTC-US)漲4.75%，超微(AMD-US)漲3.87%。
台股ADR跌漲互見。台積電ADR(TSM-US)上漲3.21%；日月光 ADR(ASX-US)上漲6.27%；聯電ADR(UMC-US)上漲1.90%；中華電信ADR(CHT-US)上漲0.54%。

企業新聞

Anthropic(ANT-US)周五大漲10.98%，收在每股91.88美元，重新站上每股83美元的首次公開發行(IPO)價，反映AI交易全面回溫，吸引從假期重返市場的投資人，分析師的正面評等也為股價提供支撐。
由阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)領導的Anthropic目前市值約1.7兆美元，仍低於11月19日掛牌首日股價觸及115.10美元時、市值一度超過2兆美元的高點。 投資人接下來將觀察，Anthropic能否在12月15日閉鎖期屆滿前，持續守住IPO發行價
SpaceX(SPCX-US)勁揚4.83%，報每股133.59美元。全球首富馬斯克在感恩節當天於社群平台X發文表示，除了贈送美國每個兒童2股SpaceX股票之外，每年還會加碼贈送1股，以目前股價計算，每年額外贈股的總價值將近90億美元。
輝達周五盤中走勢震盪，終場勉力上漲0.8%，報每股150.49美元。黃仁勳戲劇性回鍋擔任執行長之後，預定下周四赴美國參議院銀行委員會作證，將成為市場焦點。標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)周三則將輝達信用評等列入「負向觀察」名單，代表評等遭調降的可能性很高。
行動通訊巨頭威瑞森(Verizon Communications)(VZ-US)上漲0.55%，報每股47.54美元。《金融時報》(FT)報導，該公司正洽談以60億美元收購寬頻業者Fidium，藉此擴大網路版圖，在全美吸引更多網路服務用戶。
Vertex Pharmaceuticals(VRTZ-US)重挫5.2%，報每股534.57美元。美國監管機關宣布，該公司治療慢性腎臟疾病藥物的核准決定將延後最多三個月，為此藥上市之路新增障礙。

華爾街分析

經過數周市場不安，投資人持續質疑AI支出能否帶來相應回報，企業借貸成本上升、監管趨嚴，以及這項技術帶來的風險等問題，仍未獲得解答。市場接下來將密切觀察，AI股這波賣壓是否已經告一段落。
摩根士丹利投資管理公司資深投資組合經理Andrew Slimmon說：「科技股反彈從周一開始，周三盤中反轉後延續，今天又持續走高。大量短線資金已經解除科技股部位，這波反彈下周可能持續，因為這些資金被迫回頭追買。」
Annex財富管理公司分析師Brian Jacobsen表示，當市場發現原先擔憂的風險並未實現，先前的避險賣壓最終就會逆轉。他並指出，長期投資人會把市場修正視為重新檢視持股的時機，而不是退出市場的理由。
Jacobsen表示：「購物者在這個假期購物季會尋找便宜貨，沒有理由認為投資人不能做同樣的事。」
目前由於風險偏好回升，投資人減少對美國公債等避險資產的需求。
The Sevens Report的Tom Essaye指出，本周市場表現最重要的訊息是，AI投資題材仍有許多問題亟待解決。他表示：「在市場能夠清楚掌握接下來的發展之前，我們應該預期波動將持續。」
下周市場焦點將轉向美國11月非農就業報告，這是Fed 12月8日至9日政策會議前最受矚目的經濟數據，若數據顯示美國經濟愈來愈熱絡，可能促使央行採取更強硬的立場，對已經遭受重創的股票構成壓力。
根據LSEG調查的經濟學家預估，美國11月非農就業人口將增加9萬人，失業率為4.1%。10月非農就業人口則大增16.5萬人，遠高於經濟學家的預期。
Wealth Enhancement資深投資策略師Ayako Yoshioka說：「強勁的經濟成長背景，只會給Fed另一個更有信心升息的理由。因此，這是一把雙面刃。」
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主
paras_en: AI stocks sounded the rebound bugle, helping all major U.S. indices close higher on Friday (the 27th) and ending a volatile week that was shortened by the holiday. The Dow rose nearly 600 points, its biggest weekly gain since 2022, while the S&P 500 posted its best weekly performance since April 2025.
U.S. markets were closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving, and although trading resumed on Friday, the session ended early.

Chip stocks that had been hammered this month reclaimed some of their recent losses, with Micron (MU‑US) and Marvell (MRVL‑US) up 7.6% and 7.3% respectively on Friday. AI‑benefiting names also surged: data‑storage firm Sandisk (SNDK‑US) jumped almost 16%, while optical‑product maker Lumentum (LITE‑US) and server maker Dell (DELL‑US) rose 8% and 6.7% respectively.
Large‑scale AI cloud providers (hyperscalers) – Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) – all saw their shares rise.

Trump admitted on Thursday that recent market turbulence had worried him. The swing was especially sharp, reflecting a further escalation of the volatility that has loomed over Wall Street for months and underscoring the growing financial and economic stakes behind the AI boom.
Data released earlier this week showed U.S. Q3 growth far outpacing estimates and October inflation accelerating. Traders are almost unanimously betting that the Fed will raise rates in December.

The Dow Industrial Average climbed 5.46%, the S&P 500 rose 5.6%, and the Nasdaq gained 6.68%, giving the three major indices their best Thanksgiving‑week performance since 2008. Back then, during the financial crisis, the weekly gains were 9.7%, 12% and 10.9% respectively.

However, the rebound this week was still insufficient to erase the declines since November, and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq could end up delivering their worst November performance since 2008. Markets worry that a Democratic win in the U.S. midterms could tighten AI regulation, and that monetary policy is likely to stay restrictive, both weighing on equities.
U.S. market performance on Friday (the 27th):

The Dow Industrial Average rose 591.99 points, or 1.18%, to close at 50,774.94.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 543.70 points, or 2.31%, to finish at 24,129.50.
The S&P 500 added 114.71 points, or 1.60%, to end at 7,297.49.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 411.84 points, or 4.69%, to settle at 9,186.71.
The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 452.98 points, or 2.82%, to close at 16,510.93.

All 11 S&P sector groups were up, with basic materials and technology leading the gains.

Key stocks

Most of the five big‑cap tech names in the NYSE FANG+ Index were higher. Meta (META‑US) rose 3.13%; Apple (AAPL‑US) up 0.83%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) slipped 0.68%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) gained 0.60%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) climbed 3.96%.

Almost all components of the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index were higher. Coherent (COHR‑US) surged more than 14%; Micron (MU‑US) jumped 7.6%; Marvell (MRVL‑US) rose 7.3%; Intel (INTC‑US) up 4.75%; AMD (AMD‑US) up 3.87%.
Taiwan ADRs showed mixed moves. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) rose 3.21%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) up 6.27%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) up 1.90%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) up 0.54%.

Company news

Anthropic (ANT‑US) surged 10.98% on Friday to close at $91.88, retaking its IPO price of $83 and reflecting a broad AI‑trade rebound that attracted investors returning from the holiday. Positive analyst ratings also supported the price.

Led by Dario Amodei, Anthropic now has a market value of about $1.7 trillion, still below the peak of over $2 trillion it briefly hit when the stock first traded on November 19 at $115.10. Investors will watch whether Anthropic can hold its IPO price through the December 15 lock‑up expiration.

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) jumped 4.83% to $133.59 per share. Billionaire Elon Musk posted on X on Thanksgiving that, in addition to giving every U.S. child two shares of SpaceX stock, he will add one more share each year. At current prices, the annual extra‑share giveaway is worth nearly $9 billion.

NVIDIA was volatile during the session on Friday but managed a modest 0.8% gain to close at $150.49. After Jensen Huang dramatically returned as CEO, he is slated to testify before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee next Thursday, making him a market focal point. S&P Global Ratings placed NVIDIA on a “negative watch” list on Wednesday, indicating a high likelihood of a rating downgrade.

Verizon Communications (VZ‑US) rose 0.55% to $47.54. The Financial Times reported the company is negotiating a $6 billion acquisition of broadband provider Fidium to expand its network footprint and attract more U.S. broadband customers.

Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTZ‑US) fell 5.2% to $534.57. U.S. regulators announced that approval of the company’s chronic kidney disease drug will be delayed by up to three months, adding another hurdle to the product’s launch.

Wall Street analysis

After weeks of market unease, investors continue to question whether AI spending will generate commensurate returns. Rising corporate borrowing costs, tighter regulation, and the inherent risks of the technology remain unresolved. The market will watch closely to see if the selling pressure on AI stocks has finally abated.

Andrew Slimmon, a senior portfolio manager at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, said: “The tech rebound started on Monday, continued after a mid‑week reversal, and kept climbing today. A lot of short‑term capital has already exited tech positions, so this bounce could persist into next week as that capital is forced to chase stocks back.”

Brian Jacobsen, an analyst at Annex Wealth Management, said that when the market sees the feared risks not materializing, the earlier hedging sell‑off will reverse. He added that long‑term investors tend to view corrections as an opportunity to reassess holdings rather than a reason to exit.
Jacobsen noted: “Shoppers look for bargains during the holiday season, and there’s no reason investors can’t do the same.”
Currently, with risk appetite returning, investors are reducing demand for safe‑haven assets such as U.S. Treasuries.

Tom Essaye of The Sevens Report said the most important takeaway from this week’s market action is that many questions surrounding AI investment remain unresolved. He warned: “Until the market can clearly see what comes next, we should expect volatility to continue.”

Next week’s focus will shift to the U.S. November non‑farm payroll report, the most closely watched data point ahead of the Fed’s Dec 8‑9 policy meeting. A stronger‑than‑expected reading could push the central bank toward a more hawkish stance, adding pressure to stocks that have already taken a hit.
Economists surveyed by LSEG expect November non‑farm payrolls to increase by 90,000 jobs, with the unemployment rate at 4.1%. October’s payrolls rose by 165,000, well above expectations.

Ayako Yoshioka, senior investment strategist at Wealth Enhancement, said: “Robust economic‑growth fundamentals only give the Fed another reason to feel confident about raising rates. So it’s a double‑edged sword.”

paras_en: On November 27, U.S. markets resumed trading after Thanksgiving, with buying pressure returning to AI stocks that had recently fallen sharply. All three major indices closed higher in the half‑day session. The Nasdaq Composite rose 2.31%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index jumped 4.7%, and Nvidia, which had been under pressure in the morning, turned positive before the close. All three indices posted weekly gains, and the S&P 500 logged its biggest weekly increase since April of last year.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 591.99 points, or 1.18%, to finish at 50,774.94; the S&P 500 gained 114.71 points, or 1.60%, to end at 7,297.49; and the Nasdaq Composite climbed 543.70 points, or 2.31%, to close at 24,129.50. Over the week, the Dow was up 5.46%, the S&P 500 up 5.6%, and the Nasdaq up 6.68%.

Chip stocks were the main drivers of the rebound. Memory‑chip maker Micron (MU‑US) rose 7.6%, Marvell (MRVL‑US) gained 7.3%, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) finished up 0.8%. Buying also spread to other AI‑equipment suppliers, with storage‑chip company SanDisk (SNDK‑US) surging nearly 16%, while optical‑communications firm Lumentum (LITE‑US) and server maker Dell (DELL‑US) also posted noticeable gains.

Major cloud players Amazon (AMZN‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Oracle (ORCL‑US) all closed higher, and Tesla (TSLA‑US) rose 5%. The rebound was not limited to tech stocks; JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) climbed close to 2%, lifting the S&P 500 banking index by 1.6%.

Despite the weekly bounce, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq remain down for November overall. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s return this week had previously sparked a surge in AI stocks, but investors are still weighing whether new revenue can keep pace with spending after the tech sector’s massive debt‑financed data‑center build‑out. The U.S. Q3 growth rate has been revised upward, October inflation accelerated, and interest‑rate futures now almost fully price in the Fed’s expected December rate hike.

Looking ahead, Jensen Huang will appear before the U.S. Senate Banking Committee’s export‑control hearing on December 3. The U.S. non‑farm payroll report for November will be released on December 4, with the market forecasting an addition of 90,000 jobs, down from October’s 165,000. This data will be a key gauge of whether employment is cooling before the Fed meets on December 8‑9.

items.title_en: US Stocks Early Session: AI Buying Returns, Major Indices Rise, S&P 500 Targets Best Weekly Gain Since April
paras: 美股周五(27日)在感恩節假期後恢復交易，三大指數同步開高，先前遭重挫的人工智慧(AI)相關股票吸引買盤回流，道瓊工業指數上漲約300點。隨著市場風險偏好回升，美債避險需求降溫，華爾街可望以漲勢為動盪的一周收尾。
道瓊指數朝2025年4月以來最佳單周表現邁進，標普500指數也可望創下4月以來最大單周漲幅。不過，AI投資能否帶來足夠回報、借貸成本上升與監管風險等疑慮仍未消退，反彈能否延續仍是市場焦點。

AI股買盤回籠 輝達續吐近期漲幅

AI交易回溫，帶動先前一度逼近熊市的那斯達克100指數走揚，半導體類股指標也同步上漲。不過，輝達(NVDA-US)持續回吐近期大漲後的部分漲幅，走勢與整體晶片股不同調。
過去數周，投資人持續質疑科技業龐大的AI支出能否轉化為實際收益，相關股票因此承受賣壓。如今買盤重新進場，交易員正觀察這波拋售最劇烈的階段是否已經過去。
然而，股價反彈尚未替AI交易的核心問題提供答案。除了投資報酬，市場仍須面對借貸成本上升、監管措施，以及AI技術本身可能帶來的風險。
The Sevens Report的Tom Essaye表示，本周市場表現最大的啟示，是AI交易仍有許多問題有待解決。在市場對後續發展形成更清楚的判斷之前，投資人應預期波動將持續。

分析師看待回檔機會 美債避險需求降溫

Annex Wealth Management的Brian Jacobsen指出，當市場擔憂的情境沒有成真，先前因恐懼而進行的交易就會逐步回轉，賣壓最終也會逆轉。因此，長期投資人通常把回檔視為重新檢視持股的時機。
他以年末購物季比喻，消費者會在假期尋找便宜商品，投資人同樣可以尋找價格合適的標的。
隨著風險偏好回升，投資人降低對美國公債的避險需求。銅價則延續自11個月低點以來的反彈，創下1月以來最大漲幅。
油價也朝本月首度單周上漲邁進。中東能源基礎設施與油輪遭受的攻擊升級，引發市場對原油供應可能中斷的擔憂。

AI‑related stocks, which had previously suffered steep losses, attracted a return of buying interest, lifting the Dow Jones Industrial Average by about 300 points. As market risk appetite improves and demand for safe‑haven US Treasuries eases, Wall Street is poised to close a turbulent week on a positive note.

The Dow is on track for its best single‑week performance since April 2025, and the S&P 500 is also poised to record its largest weekly gain since April. However, doubts remain about whether AI investments can deliver sufficient returns, and concerns over rising borrowing costs and regulatory risks have not faded, keeping the sustainability of the rebound in focus.

AI buying pressure returns, Nvidia continues to give back recent gains. AI trading warms up, pulling the Nasdaq‑100, which had been edging toward bear market territory, higher, and semiconductor sector indices rise in tandem. Yet Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is still shedding part of its recent surge, moving out of step with broader chip stocks.

In recent weeks investors have repeatedly questioned whether the massive AI spending by tech firms can translate into real earnings, putting pressure on related stocks. With buying now back in, traders are watching to see if the most intense phase of the sell‑off has passed.

Nevertheless, the price rebound has not answered the core issues of AI trading. Beyond investment returns, the market still faces higher borrowing costs, regulatory measures, and the inherent risks of AI technology itself.

Tom Essaye of The Sevens Report said the biggest takeaway from this week’s market action is that AI trading still has many unresolved problems. Until the market forms a clearer view of future developments, investors should expect volatility to continue.

Analysts see pull‑back opportunities as US Treasury safe‑haven demand cools. Brian Jacobsen of Annex Wealth Management noted that when feared scenarios fail to materialise, trades made out of fear gradually reverse and selling pressure eventually flips. Consequently, long‑term investors often view pull‑backs as a chance to reassess holdings.
He likened it to the year‑end shopping season: consumers hunt for bargains during the holidays, and investors can similarly look for attractively priced targets.
With risk appetite returning, investors are reducing their safe‑haven demand for US government bonds. Copper continues its rebound from an 11‑month low, posting its biggest gain since January.

items.title: 惡劣天氣夾擊美國感恩節 強風豪雨釀大停電 全美數千航班延誤取消
items.title_en: Severe Weather Hits US Thanksgiving, Strong Winds and Heavy Rain Cause Massive Power Outages, Thousands of Flights Delayed or Canceled Nationwide
paras: 美國感恩節假期遭遇罕見的惡劣天氣與高通膨雙重衝擊，自西海岸至東海岸皆受暴風雨、強風與巨浪影響，嚴重打亂民眾的佳節規劃。
東岸地區遭遇強降雨與大風襲擊，導致賓夕法尼亞州、新澤西州、維吉尼亞州及馬里蘭州等地大範圍停電，斷電用戶數一度突破百萬人。對此，賓夕法尼亞州州長Josh Shapiro表示，電力公司搶修人員正不眠不休地投入供電恢復工作。
在交通方面，美國汽車協會(AAA)預估假期期間全美將有8,150萬人出行，但惡劣天氣造成全美數千架航班延誤、數百架航班取消，公路與鐵路運輸也陷入混亂。
在紐約市，中央公園錄得有記錄以來最潮濕的感恩節，降雨量達1.82英吋(約51毫米)，紐約州與新澤西州均宣布進入緊急狀態。強風豪雨逼使標誌性的「梅西百貨感恩節大遊行」在其百年歷史中首度延期至周六舉行。
此外，美國國家氣象局(NWS)對華盛頓特區發布沿海洪水警報，並特別呼籲大眾：「請採取必要措施保護易受洪水影響的財產。若必須出行，請勿繞過路障或駛入深度不明的水域。」美國總統川普指出，正考慮釋放聯邦緊急資金以協助災後救援。
除了天災肆虐，高通膨與燃料價格居高不下也讓緊接而來的「黑色星期五」購物季蒙上陰影。美國全國零售聯合會(NRF)預計將有1.83億名消費者購物，但許多民眾直言高昂的生活成本影響了消費抉擇，計畫減少送禮人數或購買較平價的商品。
聯合會補充指出，今年有59%的消費者計畫利用人工智慧(AI)協助尋找購物推薦與比價，顯示民眾在經濟壓力下購物策略轉趨謹慎與理性。
paras_en: Thanksgiving holiday in the United States faced a rare double blow of severe weather and high inflation, with storms, strong winds and huge waves affecting the country from the West Coast to the East Coast, seriously disrupting people’s holiday plans.

The East Coast experienced heavy rain and strong winds, leading to widespread power outages in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Virginia and Maryland, with the number of customers without electricity at one point exceeding one million. Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro said utility crews were working around the clock to restore power.

In terms of transportation, the American Automobile Association (AAA) estimated that 81.5 million people would travel nationwide during the holiday, but the bad weather caused thousands of flights across the United States to be delayed and hundreds to be canceled, while road and rail transport also fell into chaos.

In New York City, Central Park recorded the wettest Thanksgiving on record, with rainfall reaching 1.82 inches (about 51 mm), and both New York State and New Jersey declared a state of emergency. The iconic Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade was postponed for the first time in its century‑long history, moving to Saturday due to the strong winds and heavy rain.

The National Weather Service (NWS) also issued a coastal flood warning for Washington, D.C., urging the public: “Take necessary measures to protect property vulnerable to flooding. If you must travel, do not bypass roadblocks or drive into water of unknown depth.” President Trump said the federal government is considering releasing emergency funds to aid post‑disaster relief.

Beyond the natural disaster, high inflation and soaring fuel prices have cast a shadow over the upcoming Black Friday shopping season. The National Retail Federation (NRF) expects 183 million consumers to shop, but many say the high cost of living is influencing their spending choices, with plans to give fewer gifts or buy cheaper items.

The NRF added that 59 % of consumers this year plan to use artificial intelligence (AI) to help find shopping recommendations and compare prices, indicating that shoppers are adopting more cautious and rational strategies under economic pressure.

items.title: 馬斯克預言：Optimus機器人18個月內包辦家務 人人會想買一至兩台
items.title_en: Musk Predicts Optimus Robots Will Handle Household Chores Within 18 Months, Everyone Will Want One or Two
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)預言，旗下 Optimus 人形機器人預計在大約一年至一年半(12 到 18 個月)內，即可具備洗碗與倒垃圾等日常家務處理能力。馬斯克更樂觀表示，一旦機器人成功掌握這些家務技能，「幾乎所有人都會想要一台，甚至兩台」。
這項展望是馬斯克於 11 月 18 日出席 TomorrowX 峰會時所發表。當時，阿特雷迪斯管理公司(Atreides Management)首席投資官Gavin Baker在會中提出疑問，並坦言自己平時非常不喜歡倒垃圾或洗碗。針對貝克提出的家務痛點，馬斯克回應指出，Optimus 機器人在 12 至 18 個月內就能夠實現貝克所描述的家務處理能力。
馬斯克坦言，目前人形機器人雖然已經能夠在舞台上表演跳舞，甚至流暢做出後空翻等高難度動作，但若要把餐盤上乾涸的剩菜殘渣刮乾淨，對機器人而言完全是另一項挑戰。
儘管如此，特斯拉團隊評估 Optimus 機器人距離真正解決這項家務考驗，僅需大約一年到一年半的時間。
馬斯克強調，一旦 Optimus 能突破技術難關並幫忙處理洗碗與倒垃圾等居家瑣事，市場需求將會相當驚人，屆時幾乎每個人都會想要購入一台、甚至是兩台機器人來協助日常生活。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk forecast that its Optimus humanoid robot will be capable of everyday chores such as washing dishes and taking out the trash within roughly a year to a year and a half (12 to 18 months). Musk added that once the robot masters these tasks, “almost everyone will want one, maybe even two.”

He made this projection while speaking at the TomorrowX summit on November 18. During the event, Atreides Management’s chief investment officer Gavin Baker raised a question, admitting he personally dislikes taking out the trash or washing dishes. In response to Baker’s pain point, Musk said the Optimus robot could achieve the described household‑task capability within 12 to 18 months.

Musk acknowledged that although humanoid robots can already perform on‑stage dances and even execute complex moves like backflips, scraping dried food residue off a plate is an entirely different challenge for the machines.
Nevertheless, the Tesla team estimates that solving this household‑task hurdle will take roughly one to one and a half years for the Optimus robot.

Musk emphasized that once Optimus overcomes the technical barrier and can handle dishwashing and trash‑taking, market demand will be astonishing, with virtually everyone wanting to purchase one—or even two—robots to assist with daily life.
